g.text: Cells are point [95% interval] from coefficient draws of the fitted model; the placebo row prints its pre-registered

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: 90% interval. A positive value moves an edge up or outward, or enlarges the area. Because a season pair with no rule

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: change moved beyond its margin, no step is attributed to its rule; the 2025 and 2026 labels name the period only.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #4d4d4d

g.text: Dashes: not estimated for that row.
